stumbles.quote: The game tells you when to turn the phone to landscape, so the system rotation only gets in the way.
stumbles.why: Unclear how the game prompts you if the screen is locked in portrait, and whether landscape will display correctly with rotation locked. It seems to conflict with turning the phone to landscape.

stumbles.quote: When the game prompts you, turn the phone to landscape
stumbles.why: It doesn't say when this prompt appears (after Start engine?) or what it looks like. Also unclear which landscape direction to use.

stumbles.quote: Top of the phone away from you
stumbles.why: In landscape, 'top of the phone' is ambiguous: it could mean the edge that is physically up or the edge that points away. Not defined for the landscape orientation.

stumbles.quote: The first screen is held in portrait.
stumbles.why: 'Held' is unclear: it could mean the game locks portrait, or that you must hold the phone in portrait.
The button is never explained. It's unclear whether it begins the race or only leads to a landscape prompt and the start lights.

stumbles.quote: On iOS, allow motion access when the browser asks.
stumbles.why: Android is not mentioned, so it's unclear whether any permission or setting is needed there.
No options or range are given, unlike Track. It's unclear whether this is a number entry or a choice.
No options are listed, and the text doesn't say what difficulty changes.

point: Open the page on a motion-sensor phone with rotation locked in portrait, pick a track, laps and difficulty, tap Start engine, then turn to landscape and hold steady, because the start-light moment sets neutral tilt, and then tilt to steer, accelerate and brake.
